title: Enchantment Blocker
description: A mod disable specific enchantments from appearing anywhere (loot, enchanting table, mobs).Configurable by enchantment IDs, supports multiple entries.
body:
Enchantment Blocker is a lightweight mod that disables specific enchantments across your Minecraft world
_(This mod was AI-generated and may require manual adjustments for optimal performance.)_.

It blocks enchantments by removing them form generated loot,mob equipment and enchanting table,and scan the disabled enchantments from players' inventories every 2 seconds.
_(Scan interval can be increased in config for large servers,future update will checks only when inventory changes for better performance.)_

A config file will be generated on first launch,you can simply toggle individual functions on/off.
